pages.title: North America Power Mix Brief
key_points: Frame the site as a compact internal review for Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
Expose the metric years used in the site.
Show the brand mark and a short subtitle.
pages.note_summary: This page should establish scope and data years without turning into an executive summary.

pages.title: Agenda
key_points: List the required sections in contract order.
Add one short line explaining that the site uses common-year snapshots where possible.
pages.note_summary: Keep this page compact and directional.

pages.title: Country Snapshot
key_points: Include a comparison table for population, GDP, annual CO2, and top latest power source.
Add a short explainer under the table.
pages.note_summary: The table should be the main element. The explainer should interpret the comparison instead of repeating labels.

pages.title: Power Mix Comparison
key_points: Show the latest common-year power mix by source for all three countries.
Include a legend and a short interpretation.
pages.note_summary: This page should make the contrast across source mixes easy to scan.

pages.title: Emissions Trend
key_points: Show the recent common CO2 window for all three countries.
Call out the direction of change in a short paragraph.
pages.note_summary: The explainer should mention the window boundaries and at least one directional takeaway.

pages.title: Implications
key_points: Summarize three regional takeaways in compact cards: GDP scale, lowest latest annual CO2 total, and clean-generation lead.
Include a short callout naming the bundled data sources.
pages.note_summary: Cards should be evidence-led, tied to the earlier pages, and clearly name the country each takeaway belongs to.

pages.title: Appendix
key_points: Provide country profile notes for capital city, income level, and region.
Include a method note describing common-year handling.
pages.note_summary: Keep this page concise and structured.
